title: Relief valve approval.
officialText:
Temperature and pressure relief valves, or combinations thereof, and energy cutoff devices shall bear
the label of an approved agency and shall have a temperature setting of not more than 210°F (99°C) and a pressure setting not
exceeding the tank or water heater manufacturer’s rated working pressure or 150 psi (1035 kPa), whichever is less. The relieving
capacity of each pressure relief valve and each temperature relief valve shall equal or exceed the heat input to the water heater or
storage tank.
